title: AI estimated this would take me a week. I shipped it to production in 2 hours.
author: NG1Chuck
selftext:
I'm building a competitive multiplayer RTS called ROMA 2443:

https://roma2443.vermicelle.eu

Today I implemented server sharding.

Before, every player joined the same game server. Now players are automatically distributed across multiple servers, allowing the game load to be shared horizontally.

What impressed me most wasn't the technical result itself, but the speed.

The AI assistant estimated the work at roughly one week of development. Between architecture discussions, implementation, testing, deployment, and debugging, that sounded reasonable.

Instead, I worked with AI throughout the process and had the entire sharding system implemented, tested, and running in production in about 2 hours.

A task that would normally require designing server allocation, routing players correctly, handling shard awareness, updating backend logic, and validating deployments became dramatically faster.

This is so impressive

comments.author: Lope_F
comments.body: On a hobby level or indie level, it’s fine for what it is. I did he same thing on a few weekend vibecodes games I created, sent it over to two different senior engineers and developers, not a single one passed their audit and failed hard.
